tone.description: Output (TX) tone — CTCSS Hz or DCS code prefixed with D.

input_tone.description: Input (RX) tone — CTCSS Hz or DCS code prefixed with D.

access.description: Public repeaters are open to all; Closed repeaters require the owner to grant access before tones are revealed.

owner.description: Callsign of the repeater operator. Matched against a joining member's callsign to link ownership.

owner_user_id.description: App user id of the linked owner, set automatically when a member with a matching callsign joins.

hidden.description: When true, the repeater is hidden from public maps and directories (incorrect/duplicate entries).

tag_ids.description: IDs of Tag records applied to this repeater for filtering and organization.

category_id.description: ID of the primary Category record for this repeater.

radio_service.description: Radio service used by this repeater directory entry.

discord_notified_at.description: Timestamp when the community submission notification was posted to Discord.
